market_definition: The optically clear adhesives market comprises high-transparency liquid and film adhesives that bond display layers, covers and sensors with minimal haze and yellowing. It measures sales of liquid optically clear adhesive (LOCA) and optically clear adhesive films. BY FORM: Optically Clear Adhesive Films, Liquid Optically Clear Adhesive (LOCA). BY CHEMISTRY: Acrylic, Silicone, Polyurethane / Other. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Smartphones & Tablets, Automotive Displays, Televisions & Monitors, Wearables & AR / VR, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: UV-curable adhesives for non-display use; ordinary transparent tapes; display panels and cover glass. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms. GEOGRAPHY OF THIS LIST: EUROPE - companies headquartered in a European country (EU, United Kingdom, EFTA, Western Balkans, Ukraine, Moldova, Russia).
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER.
